authors: University of Cape Town Pathology Learning Centre
title: Student histopathology slide set
citation: University of Cape Town Digital Pathology / Pathology Learning Centre, student slide-set case records, current collection records (2026).
tags: South Africa; Cape Town; pathology; histopathology; teaching slides; student slide set; virtual microscopy; object records
note: UCT’s object-level Digital Pathology records identify numbered members of a historical student slide set used for practical histopathology teaching for many decades. Individual records call the set approximately 100 slides or 100 slides; this bibliography therefore retains the collection scale as about 100 rather than manufacturing an exact current physical count. Representative records include slide 21 (acute renal infarct), slide 35 (actinomycosis of liver), slide 64 (pleomorphic adenoma) and slide 85 (bronchopneumonia), each with a UCT catalogue number.

title: The incidence and pathology of tumours of domesticated animals in South Africa: a study of the Onderstepoort collection of neoplasms with special reference to their histopathology
citation: Cecil Jackson, The incidence and pathology of tumours of domesticated animals in South Africa: a study of the Onderstepoort collection of neoplasms with special reference to their histopathology, The Onderstepoort Journal of Veterinary Science and Animal Industry, vol. 6 (Pretoria: Government Printer, 1936).
tags: South Africa; Onderstepoort; veterinary pathology; histopathology; microscopic preparations; neoplasms; reference collection
note: Jackson reports that more than 18,000 pathological specimens had passed through Onderstepoort’s histological diagnostic service over roughly fifteen years and describes a programme to establish a complete collection of microscopic preparations representative of the pathology of domesticated animals in South Africa, coordinated with the macroscopic pathology museum. The 18,000 figure is a submitted-specimen workload, not a microscopic-slide count.
